required_positive_contract_scope: same probe id for matched intervention/control pair
hard_semantic_fences: delivery/coherence/recurrence/majority/self-report do not establish semantic uptake or hidden-state causality

mapping.transformerlens_primitive: none; experiment identity is caller/harness responsibility
mapping.f2_adapter_requirement: F2 must mint/bind probe_id outside TransformerLens and attach it to both control and intervention receipts.

mapping.transformerlens_primitive: model calls accept explicit token tensors; Bridge exposes original HF model and configuration but may force eager attention and has BOS/tokenizer behavior
mapping.f2_adapter_requirement: Digest exact token_ids, attention mask, tokenizer identity/revision, model checkpoint identity, dtype, device, attention implementation, seed/determinism controls and all forward kwargs; matched pair may differ only in the declared intervention field.

mapping.transformerlens_primitive: run_with_hooks / generic_activation_patch identify hook name and insert a clean cached activation into a corrupted run
mapping.f2_adapter_requirement: Bind broadcast id/digest/cycle/generation plus hook canonical name, layer/position/head index where applicable, source-cache digest, patch setter identity/version and adapter/TransformerLens commit into the intervention receipt.

mapping.transformerlens_primitive: none; activation hooks observe model tensors, not F2 GWT recipient receipt completeness or OFFERED/DELIVERED/UPTAKEN semantics
mapping.f2_adapter_requirement: Keep WP507 recipient-scoped uptake receipts authoritative for this contract. TransformerLens evidence can only supplement them as a separate mechanistic measurement channel.

mapping.transformerlens_primitive: generic_activation_patch computes a caller-provided metric from patched logits; run_with_hooks returns model output
mapping.f2_adapter_requirement: Persist/digest raw declared downstream output (or a canonical bounded projection) for both pair members in addition to the predeclared metric; never rely on a scalar metric alone as the causal receipt.

identity_and_equivalence_risks.risk: Legacy HookedTransformer loader transforms represented weights by default (fold_ln, weight centering, unembed centering, value-bias folding).
identity_and_equivalence_risks.mitigation: Do not use legacy from_pretrained as the exact-identity reference path. Prefer v3 TransformerBridge raw-HF mode or explicitly disable transformations and still independently verify equivalence.

identity_and_equivalence_risks.risk: TransformerBridge forces eager attention for hook visibility and documents possible numerical drift versus HF default SDPA due to kernel-level op ordering.
identity_and_equivalence_risks.mitigation: Compare baseline HF using the same eager attention implementation before any intervention; predeclare exact/tolerance acceptance and fail closed on unexplained drift.

identity_and_equivalence_risks.risk: Bridge tokenizer/BOS behavior can alter tokenization relative to stock HF defaults.
identity_and_equivalence_risks.mitigation: Use pre-tokenized token IDs for matched experiments where possible and bind tokenizer revision/BOS handling in the receipt.

identity_and_equivalence_risks.risk: Repository/model-name compatibility does not prove exact checkpoint bytes consumed.
identity_and_equivalence_risks.mitigation: F2 must provide checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build and loader-consumption identity independently; TransformerLens repo/version is only instrumentation provenance.

identity_and_equivalence_risks.risk: Hook/adapter instrumentation may perturb numerics or target a semantically different internal point across model architectures.
identity_and_equivalence_risks.mitigation: Bind adapter class, canonical hook name and source commit; require unpatched-instrumented baseline equivalence before accepting patched deltas.

architecture_decision.recommended_integration_shape: optional local falsification adapter outside the canonical WP507 deterministic receipt contract
architecture_decision.why: TransformerLens provides source-observed cache/hook/activation-patching primitives and a v3 raw-HF Bridge suitable for controlled perturbations, but it does not supply F2 probe identity, recipient-scoped GWT uptake semantics, canonical state/effect authority, or exact consumed-checkpoint attestation.
architecture_decision.nonduplicate_value: Mechanistic localization/activation intervention complements current pyvene, DoWhy, OpenTelemetry, PlanOut and NNsight research lanes without replacing them.

next_gate.proposed_discriminator: One exact local checkpoint: establish HF-eager vs TransformerBridge-raw baseline equivalence on fixed token IDs and fixed deterministic controls; only if that passes, execute one single-site no-op hook control and one predeclared activation patch, recording exact output digests and instrumentation identities.
fail_closed_conditions: baseline equivalence fails outside predeclared tolerance
token IDs or non-intervention forward inputs differ across pair
attempt to infer semantic GWT uptake from activation delta alone
